fact: LLM model for every pipeline call is gpt-6.1-sol with reasoning_effort high and temperature 1 (the only temperature the model accepts).

Validation (imitation) loss correlates with development success at +0.19, the wrong sign; selecting on loss cannot work. Behavioural cloning is non-monotonic in gradient steps: success peaks near 1000 steps and is zero by 3000.
Imitation fitting is disabled by default (bc_steps 0). If fitting is turned on it must be rollout-selected on a probe manifest disjoint from the screen; fixed-budget fitting is harmful.
Promotion requires a strictly positive paired success difference whose paired t interval lower bound is above zero on the promotion set (development cases 10-39). Tied success never promotes.
The saved incumbent scores 0.000 success on the development manifest, not 0.30.

Only the five fittable_seed structures (simple_reach_push_sharp_gate, simple_damped_push, simple_reach_push, simple_reach_push_damped, simple_reach_push_shared_gain) may be fittable-lane parents; the standoff family is a non-fittable control or retired.
Stage F: no correction-LLM repair arm beat no_repair; search arms led, LLM arms were flat.

fact: The gpt-6.1-sol baseline rerun (nine unseeded zero-shot candidates) reached zero success; the gpt-5.6-sol run of the same config reached 0.333 on the promotion set.
The AC-6 repair ablation did not support the repair loop: optimizer-only 0.650 vs full loop 0.517 held-out success over six replicates.
The final-test split (config/manifests/push-v2_final_test.yaml) is locked until Phase 7, which needs the user's approval and a FreezeRecord. Qwen/E10 is also blocked.
Seeds 2400-2424 are held for config/fittable_bank/qualification_v2.yaml (predeclared, not run). New protocols pick seeds from 2600 upward.

Every protocol runs on the remote GPU box via `gpu run`, which bills by the hour; the box stays up across a session's steps and is stopped at the end. Since 2026-10-26 an idea is approved when the advisor and the implementer state the same triage position (approve); the user sets the research direction and rules only on ideas that exhaust their negotiation rounds.

Pen-spin task (vendored lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin): Isaac Lab Shadow Hand, 157-d 'full' observation, 20-d joint-target action, 60 Hz control, 360-step (6 s) episodes, num_envs default 256. Success is evaluated per step (pen centre within 0.10/0.10/0.08 m of the in-hand position and |spin_rate| above 1/3/4 rad/s for Stage 1/2/3); there is no episode-level success rule. spin_rate is the pen's angular velocity about its own long axis (roll), not end-over-end twirl. Isaac Lab runs only under ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh (its own python 3.11 venv), not .venv-metaworld.

No pretrained pen-spinning policy for this task exists publicly as of 2026-10-27: the closest work (Wang et al., 'Lessons from Learning to Spin Pens', CoRL 2024) uses an Allegro hand in Isaac Gym and end-over-end spinning. The user's order for the expert: scripted controller first; if it cannot qualify, train an RL expert with rsl_rl PPO (ShadowHandSpinPPORunnerCfg) on the box. No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls.

The policy-search pipeline (manifests, obs schema, run_episode, EXPERT_POLICY_MAP, run_full_evolution.py) is MetaWorld-only. The Isaac path today is the pre-manifest smoke script scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py with its own rollout copy (no action_space.high scaling, num_envs 1).
